rateLimits.note: Outlook's limit: 10,000 API requests in any 10 minutes per app and mailbox, with 4 requests at a time and 150 MB uploaded (PATCH, POST, PUT) per 5 minutes; counted per user (mailbox). Above it Graph answers 429 with Retry-After, which the client honours. The global limit is 130,000 requests per 10 seconds per app across all tenants.

provenance.notes: Microsoft APIs Terms of Use (last updated October 2025): a limited, revocable licence for applications offered to customers, no ban on commercial use (Microsoft may set fees or limits at any time). Ask for the minimum data and permissions; no copies or databases of the data beyond what the intended scenario needs; Outlook data without further consent only to sync or back up calendar events; data kept locally stays current (corrections and deletions mirrored), has retention and deletion rules, and is deleted when the user leaves; a privacy statement as protective as Microsoft's; no advertising use; no redistribution, resale or sublicensing of the APIs or the data (§14); no circumvention of limits. Caching and storage are marked allowed under those conditions. Permissions: Calendars.Read to read, Calendars.ReadWrite to write, offline_access for a refresh token; getSchedule's pages disagree (Calendars.ReadBasic in the reference, Calendars.Read in the concept page): Calendars.Read holds under both. getSchedule is for work or school accounts only, not personal Microsoft accounts.
